hero.title: Full transparency,
hero.sub: We explain exactly what happens at every step — for buyers, for sellers, and for everyone taking part in Private Rooms.

s1.title: Two formats,
s1.intro: On BidRoom you can buy through a live auction or submit your best offer. In both cases, your funds are protected until you confirm you received the item in good condition.

auction.desc: Bid in real time against other buyers. The highest bid when time runs out wins automatically. You can set a maximum bid and let the system bid for you.

auction.f2: Reserve price may apply — only binding if reached
auction.f3: Optional buy-now price — purchase immediately without waiting

offer.f2: You can include a message with your offer

offer.f4: The seller is not obliged to sell below the minimum price

s2.title: How to buy
s2.intro: From registration to delivery, we explain every moment of the process — including what happens if something goes wrong.

step1.title: Create your account — it's free
step1.desc: Sign up with email or Google. No membership costs or monthly fees. The account is free for buyers.

step2.title: Browse and filter by category
step2.desc: Browse categories — watches, art, cars, jewellery, antiques and more. Add listings to your watchlist to follow without bidding.

step3.title: Bid or make an offer
step3.desc:
Auction: each bid must beat the previous one by the set increment. If outbid, you receive an immediate notification.
Best offer: submit the amount you consider fair, with or without a message.
step3.note: By placing a bid or submitting an offer, you commit to making the payment if you win. Bids cannot be cancelled after placement.

step4.title: If you win — pay within 24 hours
step4.desc: When the auction closes and your bid is the winner, you have 24 hours to make the payment via Stripe. You will receive an email and platform notification.
step4.note: Payment does not go directly to the seller — it is held by BidRoom until you confirm you received the item in good condition.

step5.title: Wait for shipping — the seller has 5 business days
step5.desc: The seller has 5 business days (Monday to Friday) to ship the item after payment confirmation. If they do not ship within the deadline, the transaction is automatically cancelled and you receive a full refund.
step5.note: You don't need to do anything if the seller doesn't ship. The system automatically cancels and refunds after 5 business days.

step6.title: Confirm receipt
step6.desc: When you receive the item, confirm on the platform: Received in good condition — the transaction is completed and the seller receives payment. Received with issues — a dispute is opened; funds remain held.
step6.note: If the item arrived damaged in transit, you have 48 hours after confirming delivery to open a damage claim, with photos of the item and packaging.

step7.title: Rate the seller
step7.desc: After the transaction is completed, you can rate the seller on a scale of 1 to 10. Review descriptions are private — only the seller sees them.

faq.q0: Can I cancel a bid after placing it?
faq.a0: No. All bids and offers are binding from the moment they are placed. Only bid if you are sure you can and want to pay the indicated amount.
faq.q1: What happens if the seller doesn't ship the item?
faq.a1: If the seller doesn't ship within 5 business days, the transaction is automatically cancelled and you will receive a full refund to your original payment method.
faq.q2: Do I have a right of withdrawal?
faq.a2: BidRoom is primarily a C2C (private individuals) platform. In online auctions between private individuals, the right of withdrawal generally does not apply. If the seller is a professional, your rights are different — check the Terms of Use.
faq.q3: How much commission do I pay?
faq.a3: Buyers pay no commission to BidRoom. You only pay the item price plus the Stripe processing fee (~2.9% + €0.30 per transaction), which is added to the total at checkout.

s1.title: You only pay when you sell.
s1.intro: Listing an item on BidRoom is completely free. Commission is only charged when a transaction is successfully completed — and it is deducted automatically before payout.

comm.ex2: You receive €940 — but closes on average 32% higher
comm.note: The Stripe processing fee (~2.9% + €0.30) is borne by the buyer and added to the final amount at checkout. Payout is transferred to your bank account via Stripe Connect after the buyer confirms receipt.

s2.title: How to sell
s2.intro: From listing to payout, the process is straightforward. You never pay upfront and always receive payment after delivery is confirmed.

step1.title: Set up payments once
step1.desc: Before publishing your first listing, set up your payment account via Stripe Connect in Dashboard → Settings → Payments. You will need identity details and IBAN. This is done once and never needs to be repeated.

step2.title: Create the listing in 6 steps
step2.desc: The publishing wizard guides you through: format (auction or best offer), details, photos (up to 20), price, shipping and location, and final review. You can save as a draft at any time.
step2.note: To list or bid on items with a value equal to or greater than €5,000, identity verification is required under anti-money laundering legislation.

step3.title: Wait for the close
step3.desc:
Auction: the winner is determined automatically when time runs out. You don't need to do anything.
Best offer: you receive a notification for each proposal. You can accept or decline until the deadline. When you accept an offer, the remaining ones close automatically.

step4.title: The buyer pays — they have 24 hours
step4.desc: The buyer has 24 hours to make the payment. If they don't pay within the deadline, the transaction is cancelled and the item can be relisted.

step5.title: Ship within 5 business days
step5.desc: After payment confirmation, you have 5 business days (Monday to Friday, UTC) to ship the item. You will receive a warning on day 3. If you haven't shipped by day 5, the transaction is automatically cancelled and the buyer is refunded.
step5.note: Weekends and holidays do not count. The deadline is calculated automatically by the system from payment confirmation.

step6.title: Receive your payout automatically
step6.desc: When the buyer confirms they received the item in good condition, the funds are automatically released and transferred to your bank account via Stripe Connect (typically 1–2 banking business days).
step6.noteTitle: If the buyer doesn't confirm receipt.
step6.note: If the buyer does not confirm receipt within the deadline, the system releases the funds automatically (auto-release). You do not need to contact support.

faq.a0: Funds are released when the buyer confirms receipt. After that, the Stripe Connect transfer typically takes 1–2 banking business days.
faq.q1: Can I set a minimum price in the Best Offer format?
faq.a1: Yes, and it is actually mandatory to set a minimum price for Best Offer listings. You are not obliged to accept any offer below that amount — you have full control over what you accept.
faq.q2: What happens if the buyer opens a dispute?
faq.a2: When a dispute is opened, both accounts are restricted and funds are held. The BidRoom team reviews the evidence from both parties. If no agreement can be reached, the case is referred to the CNIACC.
faq.q3: Can I cancel a listing after publishing?
faq.a3: You can cancel a listing with no bids or offers before the deadline. Once there are bids or offers, cancellation may result in a reputation penalty. You can never cancel after the auction has ended with a winner determined.
faq.q4: What items can I not list?
faq.a4: Prohibited: live animals, controlled substances, weapons, and any item illegal in Portugal. BidRoom uses automatic moderation (Azure AI Content Safety) to detect and block these listings before they go live.

tip.title: Activate Private Room to maximise the final sale price
tip.desc: Auctions with a Private Room close on average 30% above the last public bid. The buyer who loses the main auction is often willing to pay more in an exclusive round — the Private Room captures that value for you.

private.title: Exclusivity
private.intro: A Private Room is an exclusive bidding round that takes place after the public auction — only for bidders invited by the seller. Our data shows that auctions with a Private Room close on average 32% above the starting price.

s2.eye: How it works step by step
s2.title: The complete process

step1.title: Eligibility — who can have a Private Room?
step1.desc: A Private Room is only possible in Highest Bid auctions with the option activated by the seller. For it to be triggered, the auction must have ended, the reserve (if any) must have been met, and there must be at least 2 authenticated and registered bidders.

step2.title: Seller invites — 15-minute window
step2.desc: After the auction closes, the seller has 15 minutes to create the room and invite between 2 and 5 of the bidders. A visible countdown on the listing page shows the remaining time.

step3.title: Guests accept or decline — 15 minutes
step3.desc: Each guest receives an email and notification and has 15 minutes to accept or decline. Those who don't respond within the deadline become ineligible. Exception: if exactly 2 bidders were invited and one doesn't respond, the other is automatically selected as winner.
step3.note: As soon as all guests accept, the opening countdown drops to 1 minute. The room opens and bidding begins.

step4.title: Bidding — the 60-second rule
step4.desc: Inside the room, only accepted guests can bid. Any new bid resets the timer to 60 seconds. The room closes when 60 seconds pass with no new bid. The bidder with the highest bid at the time of closing wins automatically.

step5.title: Automatic winner — full transparency
step5.desc: The system determines the winner automatically based on the highest bid. The seller has no involvement in this decision.
step5.noteTitle: If the seller abandons the room.
step5.note: If the seller leaves the room during the round, the room closes immediately with no winner and all participants are notified. This action is logged in the system.

vis.title: Who can see the room?
vis.text: Any user can view the room in observer mode. Guests who have not yet responded appear in grey; those who have accepted appear highlighted.

commission.title: Commission with Private Room
commission.text: The seller commission rises from 3.5% to 6% when the Private Room is active. This difference reflects the added value — auctions with a Private Room close significantly higher.

eligible.title: Eligibility to be invited
eligible.text: To be eligible as a Private Room guest, the buyer needs a reputation score ≥ 60 and zero lost disputes. Guest or unverified accounts are not eligible.

audit.title: Full audit trail
audit.text: All actions in a Private Room are logged in the internal audit system — invitations, acceptances, bids, and closing. Available for review in case of dispute.

faq.q0: Can I decline a Private Room invitation?
faq.a0: Yes. You can decline or ignore the invitation within 15 minutes. If fewer than 2 invited bidders remain active, the room may close or the last accepted bidder wins automatically.
faq.q1: What if only one bidder accepts?
faq.a1: If only 1 bidder accepts and the rest do not respond within the deadline, that bidder wins automatically at the value of their original bid. The room cannot exist with only one active participant.
faq.q2: Can I see who else is in the room?
faq.a2: You can see how many participants are in the room and their status, but not their names during the round. After closing, the winner is announced.
faq.q3: Do I have to bid if I accept the invitation?
faq.a3: You are not obliged to bid, but by accepting the invitation you are part of the room. You can enter and not bid — in that case another participant wins if they exceed your original bid.

escrow.title: Funds in escrow
escrow.text: The buyer's payment is held by BidRoom (via Stripe) until the buyer confirms they received the item in good condition. The seller only receives payment after that confirmation.

stripe.title: Powered by Stripe
stripe.text: All payments are processed by Stripe, the world leader in online payments. BidRoom never stores card data. Stripe is PCI DSS Level 1 compliant.

refund.title: Automatic refund
refund.text: If the seller doesn't ship within 5 business days, the refund is processed automatically. You don't need to request it — the system handles everything.

payout.title: Payout via Stripe Connect
payout.text: Sellers receive payment directly to their bank account via Stripe Connect. BidRoom deducts the commission automatically before payout — the seller receives the net amount.

p1.title: Buyer pays
p1.desc: The buyer has 24 hours after closing to make payment. Funds are held in BidRoom's Stripe escrow. If they don't pay, the transaction is cancelled.

p2.title: Seller ships
p2.desc: The seller has 5 business days to ship. On day 3 they receive a warning. On day 5, if not shipped, the system automatically cancels and refunds the buyer.

p3.title: Buyer confirms
p3.desc: The buyer confirms: item in good condition → funds released; item with issues → dispute opened. If they don't confirm within the deadline → automatic auto-release.

p4.desc: Both accounts are restricted. BidRoom attempts to facilitate an agreement within 7 business days. If no agreement, the case is referred to CNIACC. Funds remain held until final resolution.

p5.desc: Commission deducted automatically. Net amount transferred via Stripe Connect to the seller's bank account within 1–2 banking business days.

faq.a0: No. Card data is managed exclusively by Stripe, which is PCI DSS Level 1 compliant. BidRoom never has access to or stores card numbers.
faq.q1: When does the seller receive my payment?
faq.a1: The seller does not receive payment immediately. Funds are held by BidRoom until you confirm you received the item in good condition. Only then are they released. This escrow protects you from fraud.

account1.q: How do I create an account?
account1.a: Creating an account is free and easy! Click the "Start Bidding" button on our homepage, fill out the registration form with your email and password, and verify your email address. You'll be ready to start bidding in minutes.

account2.q: Is it free to create an account?
account2.a: Yes, creating an account on BidRoom is completely free. You only pay when you win an auction and need to complete your purchase.

account3.q: What payment methods do you accept?
account3.a: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), PayPal, and bank transfers. All payments are processed securely through our encrypted payment system.

account5.a: Yes, you can deactivate your account at any time through your account settings. Please note that you cannot cancel active bids or ongoing auctions.

bidding1.q: How does the bidding system work?
bidding1.a: Our proxy bidding system allows you to set your maximum bid amount. We automatically bid on your behalf up to that amount, ensuring you only pay the minimum needed to win.

bidding2.a: You can cancel a bid within 1 hour of placement, as long as the auction hasn't ended. After that, bids are final and cannot be cancelled.

bidding3.q: How do I know if I won an auction?
bidding3.a: You'll receive an email notification immediately when you win an auction. You can also check your account dashboard for all your winning bids.

bidding4.q: What happens if I don't pay for a won auction?
bidding4.a: If you don't complete payment within 48 hours of winning, the auction will be offered to the next highest bidder. Repeated non-payment may result in account suspension.

bidding5.q: Can I bid on multiple items at once?
bidding5.a: Yes, you can bid on as many items as you want simultaneously. Just make sure you have sufficient funds to cover all potential wins.

bidding6.q: How do I track my bids?
bidding6.a: You can track all your bids in your account dashboard. You'll see active bids, winning bids, and bid history all in one place.

technical1.q: The website is loading slowly. What should I do?
technical1.a: Try refreshing your browser or clearing your cache. If the problem persists, check your internet connection or try using a different browser.

technical2.q: I can't log into my account. Help!
technical2.a: First, make sure you're using the correct email and password. If you've forgotten your password, use the "Forgot Password" link on the login page.

technical3.q: Do you have a mobile app?
technical3.a: Yes! Our mobile app is available for both iOS and Android devices. You can download it from the App Store or Google Play Store.

technical4.q: Why am I not receiving email notifications?
technical4.a: Check your spam folder first. If notifications are still missing, go to your account settings and verify your email preferences are enabled.

technical5.q: Can I use BidRoom on my tablet?
technical5.a: Absolutely! BidRoom is fully responsive and works great on tablets, smartphones, and desktop computers.

shipping1.a: Shipping is handled by individual sellers. Each listing will show shipping costs and estimated delivery times. Most sellers ship within 1-3 business days.

shipping2.q: Can I return an item if I'm not satisfied?
shipping2.a: Return policies vary by seller. Check the individual listing for return information. BidRoom also offers buyer protection for eligible purchases.

shipping3.a: International shipping depends on the individual seller. Check each listing for shipping options to your country.

shipping4.q: How do I track my shipment?
shipping4.a: Once your item ships, you'll receive a tracking number via email. You can use this to track your package on the carrier's website.

security1.a: Yes, we use industry-standard encryption to protect your personal and payment information. We never share your data with third parties without your consent.

security2.a: Our buyer protection program covers eligible purchases against fraud, misrepresentation, and non-delivery. Check our terms for full details.

security3.a: If you see a suspicious listing, click the "Report" button on the item page or contact our support team immediately.

terms.h3li1: Auction (Highest Bid): buyers place real-time bids. The highest bid at the end of the period wins automatically.
terms.h3li2: Best Offer: buyers submit offers. The seller chooses their preferred offer before the deadline. The seller is not obliged to accept any offer below the minimum price set.
terms.h3p2: BidRoom may also offer Private Rooms, an optional feature where the seller invites selected bidders to an additional round after the public auction ends.
terms.h4p1: BidRoom charges the seller a commission on the final value of each completed transaction:
terms.h4p2: Stripe processing fees are borne by the buyer, added to the final transaction amount. Payments are processed by Stripe and funds are held until the buyer confirms receipt.
terms.h5li1: The seller declares they are the legitimate owner of the listed item.
terms.h5li2: The description and photographs must be true and complete.
terms.h5li3: The seller has 5 business days to ship the item after payment confirmation.
terms.h5li4: Failure to meet the shipping deadline results in automatic cancellation and a refund to the buyer.
terms.h5li5: Prohibited items include: live animals, controlled substances, weapons, and any item illegal under Portuguese or EU law.
terms.h6li1: Bids and offers are binding. By placing a bid or submitting an offer, the buyer commits to pay if they win.
terms.h6li2: Payment must be made within 24 hours of the auction closing.
terms.h6li3: The buyer must confirm receipt of the item within the stipulated period.
terms.h7p1: BidRoom is a peer-to-peer (C2C) auction platform. In online auctions between private individuals, the right of withdrawal under Decree-Law No. 24/2014 does not apply. When one party is a professional seller (business or trader), the consumer buyer has 14 days to exercise the right of withdrawal without giving a reason, under applicable law. Returns are handled directly between buyer and seller, with BidRoom mediation in case of dispute.
terms.h8p1: For transactions of €5,000 or more, BidRoom requires user identity verification (Know Your Customer — KYC) before allowing listing publication or auction participation. This requirement stems from anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing obligations (Law No. 83/2017). The user must provide valid identification. Refusal to complete KYC prevents use of features subject to this threshold.
terms.h9p1: BidRoom may suspend or close an account in the following circumstances:
terms.h9li1: Automatic suspension — whenever a dispute is opened, both accounts involved are automatically suspended until resolution.
terms.h9li2: Administrative suspension — in case of suspected fraud, breach of these Terms, or activity that puts other users at risk.
terms.h9li3: Permanent closure — in case of serious or repeated violations, or at the user's own request.
terms.h9p2: Suspended users are notified by email and may challenge the decision via contact@bidroom.pt. Transactions in progress at the time of suspension are handled case by case by BidRoom.
terms.h10p1: In case of dispute between buyer and seller, BidRoom provides an internal mediation mechanism. Both accounts are automatically suspended during the dispute period. BidRoom's decision is binding within the platform. For unresolved disputes, users may refer to the Portuguese Centre for Consumer Conflict Arbitration (CNIACC) at cniacc.pt.
terms.h11p1: BidRoom operates a reputation system scored from 0 to 100, calculated automatically based on reviews received, completed transactions, and disputes. This system has concrete effects for users:
terms.h11li1: Score ≥ 60 and zero dispute losses — eligibility for Private Rooms
terms.h11li2: Suspicious review patterns — automatic fraud detection
terms.h11li3: Very low score — may result in restricted functionality
terms.h11p2: Under GDPR Article 22, you have the right not to be subject solely to automated decisions that produce significant effects. To challenge an automated reputation decision, contact contact@bidroom.pt.
terms.h12p1: BidRoom.pt is intended exclusively for users aged 18 or over. We do not knowingly collect personal data from anyone under 18. If we learn that a minor has created an account, we will close it immediately and delete associated data. Parents or guardians who suspect a minor has created a BidRoom account should contact us at contact@bidroom.pt.
terms.h13p1: All content on BidRoom.pt — including design, code, brand, and text — is owned by BidRoom Unipessoal Lda. Users may not reproduce, distribute, or create derivative works without express written authorisation.
terms.h14p1: BidRoom acts as a technology intermediary and is not responsible for the quality, authenticity, or legality of listed items. BidRoom's maximum liability to any user, in any circumstance, is limited to commission fees paid in the last 12 months. This limitation does not affect consumers' mandatory rights under Portuguese and EU law.
terms.h15p1: These Terms are governed by Portuguese law. In case of dispute, the parties agree to submit to the courts of Lisbon, without prejudice to consumers' rights under applicable EU legislation.
terms.h16p1: BidRoom reserves the right to change these Terms at any time, with at least 15 days' notice to registered users. Continued use of the platform after that period implies acceptance of the changes.

hero.sub: BidRoom protects buyers and sellers in every transaction. Our trust system makes that protection visible — so every decision is an informed one.

tiers.title: Three tiers.
tiers.desc: Your trust tier is calculated automatically based on the steps you've completed. It's visible to all sellers when you bid — it works as your instant reputation.
tiers.t1Guarantee: ⚠️ No payment guarantee. If you don't pay after winning an auction, the seller relies solely on your reputation history.
tiers.t2Cond: Requirement: verify identity via Stripe Identity (passport or national ID).
tiers.t2Guarantee: 🔒 Your identity is known. In case of an unresolved dispute, you can be held legally accountable.
tiers.t3Cond: Requirement: KYC completed + valid credit/debit card registered on your account.
tiers.t3Guarantee: 🛡️ Automatic compensation. If you lose a dispute, BidRoom charges your saved card directly — no manual process.

levelUp.title: From Level 1 to
levelUp.desc: Three sequential steps. Each takes under 5 minutes. You can stop at any level — but Level 3 unlocks exclusive benefits.
levelUp.s1Desc: Register with email or Google. Confirm the link sent to your email. Immediate.
levelUp.s2Desc: In your Dashboard → Settings → Identity. Submit a photo of your passport or national ID via Stripe Identity. Secure and encrypted. Result in seconds.
levelUp.s3Desc: In your Dashboard → Settings → Payment Method. Save a valid card. The card is never charged preventively — only if you lose a formal dispute. Processed by Stripe (PCI DSS Level 1).

benefits.title: What you
benefits.desc: Each level unlocks concrete advantages — not just a badge.

disputes.title: What happens
disputes.desc: BidRoom acts as a facilitator, never as final arbiter. The process always has three phases before any irreversible decision.
disputes.p1Desc: The buyer opens the dispute with evidence. The seller responds within 7 business days. BidRoom analyses and attempts an agreement.
disputes.p2Desc: If mediation produces no agreement, either party can escalate to CNIACC — an independent Portuguese ADR entity.
disputes.p3Desc: Last resort. The court ruling is binding. Platform records (logs, communications, transactions) are kept for 5 years as evidence.
disputes.alertTitle: The saved card (Level 3) is never charged preventively
disputes.alertDesc: The automatic debit on the saved card only happens after a formal dispute decision resolved against the buyer — never before, never without prior email notification. The debited amount never exceeds the transaction value.

faq.title: Questions about
faq.q1: Is my trust tier public — can anyone see I have a saved card?
faq.a1: No. What's visible is only the badge — "Verified", "Identity Verified" or "Payment Guaranteed". No card, IBAN or document data is visible to third parties. The seller only knows you have a valid card registered, not which one or its details.
faq.q2: Can I remove the saved card at any time?
faq.a2: Yes, you can remove the card at any time in Dashboard → Settings → Payment Method. When you do so, your trust tier drops to Level 2 (if you have KYC) or Level 1. The badge is immediately updated on all active auctions where you've already bid.
faq.q3: What happens if my card expires?
faq.a3: You'll receive an email warning 30 days before your card expires. If the card expires without you updating it, the trust tier drops automatically. Any active dispute at that point is not affected — it remains subject to the manual process.
faq.q4: Can BidRoom charge me without my knowledge?
faq.a4: No. Any debit to the saved card is always preceded by an email notification with the amount, the reason (dispute decision), and a 48-hour contestation period. If you believe the debit is unfair, you can contact support before final processing.
faq.q5: Is identity verification (Level 2) mandatory to bid?
faq.a5: It's not mandatory for most auctions. It becomes mandatory for auctions with a value above €5,000, under the terms of Law 83/2017 (anti-money laundering). For all other auctions, Level 1 (verified email) is sufficient.

tiers.title: What each badge
tiers.desc: As a seller, you see each bidder's trust tier in real time, directly in the bid feed. Here's what each badge implies for your protection.
tiers.t1Cond: Account created and email confirmed. No additional verification.
tiers.t1Guarantee: If this buyer wins and doesn't pay or the dispute is resolved in your favour: BidRoom records the infraction in their reputation. No automatic monetary compensation.
tiers.t2Cond: Real identity confirmed via Stripe Identity.
tiers.t2Guarantee: If the dispute is resolved in your favour: the buyer's identity is known. You can hold them legally accountable. BidRoom provides the necessary records. No automatic debit.
tiers.t3Cond: KYC completed and valid card registered on BidRoom account.
tiers.t3Guarantee: If the dispute is resolved in your favour: BidRoom automatically debits the buyer's card. You receive the transaction amount directly to your IBAN.
tiers.alertDesc: When selecting guests for the Private Room, bidders with Payment Guaranteed appear suggested first. You're not required to choose them — but for high-value items, it's the safest path.

bidFeed.s1Title: See the badge in the bid feed
bidFeed.s1Desc: Each feed line shows the name + badge. The badge updates in real time if the buyer changes level during the auction (rare but possible).
bidFeed.s2Desc: Below the feed, a summary shows: "X of Y bidders with automatic compensation". Gives you a quick view of the overall risk level of the auction.
bidFeed.s3Title: Sort by guarantee in Private Room

protection.title: How we
protection.desc: Regardless of the buyer's trust tier, you have active protections at every stage of the transaction.
protection.c1Desc: The buyer has 24 hours to pay. If they don't pay, the transaction is automatically cancelled, the item returns to its original state, and the buyer receives a reputation penalty (-15 points). You can relist at no cost.
protection.c2Desc: After shipping confirmation, the delivery deadline is calculated automatically. If the buyer doesn't mark it as received, payment is released to you automatically after the deadline — no action needed.
protection.c3Desc: Both your account and the buyer's are preventively suspended. BidRoom analyses evidence from both parties. If the decision is in your favour, the buyer is debited (Level 3) or held legally accountable (Level 2).
protection.c4Desc: All communications, bids, transactions and dispute evidence are kept for 5 years. In case of legal proceedings, BidRoom makes the necessary records available for your defence.

sellerTrust.title: Buyers also
sellerTrust.desc: Trust isn't just for buyers. Buyers see your profile — and decide whether to trust you to deliver what you promised.
sellerTrust.colFeature: What buyers see on your profile
sellerTrust.r1How: Deliver on time, communicate well, describe the item accurately
sellerTrust.r3How: Always ship within 5 business days after payment
sellerTrust.r5How: In Settings → Seller classification — fill in accurately
sellerTrust.alertDesc: If you sell regularly and for commercial purposes (trader), you must classify yourself as a "Professional seller" in Settings. This is a legal obligation under the DSA (Digital Services Act) — and gives you access to invoicing and advanced analytics features.

faq.title: Questions about
faq.q1: Can I refuse a Level 1 buyer before the auction ends?
faq.a1: You cannot refuse bids based on trust tier during a public auction — that would go against the open market principle. What you can do is activate the Private Room and select only buyers with your preferred tier for the exclusive round.
faq.q2: If a Level 3 buyer wins and doesn't pay, am I automatically compensated?
faq.a2: Level 3 refers to compensation in case of a dispute resolved in your favour — not immediate non-payment. For non-payment, the process is the same regardless of tier: automatic cancellation after 24h, buyer reputation penalty, and you can relist the item for free.
faq.q3: What happens to my payment while a dispute is open?
faq.a3: Funds are held in escrow while the dispute is active. Your account and the buyer's are preventively suspended. The hold is lifted immediately after the decision, whether in your favour (payout) or the buyer's (refund).
faq.q4: My listing is incorrectly described and I want to withdraw it. Is there a penalty?
faq.a4: You can cancel a listing with no bids without any penalty. If there are already bids, cancellation may affect your reputation and requires justification. Items with bids cannot be cancelled unilaterally — contact support for exceptional cases.
